//: Drives the typecheck/lint and the clean d.ts (`bun x tsc`); the lowering itself runs on the Go/ttsc engine during the Bun.build emit (build.ts). The tokenless forms this library authors are ordinary manifest members, so plain tsc checks them with no plugin. module:ESNext keeps relative .js specifiers verbatim so node ESM resolves the emitted dist at runtime; moduleResolution:Bundler maps them back to source at compile time.
